newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude extends fall in late US paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude extends fall in late US paper trading.

text.p: North Sea benchmark Brent crude oil dropped in late U.S. paper trading on Friday, extending the day's sharp losses, traders said.
Five July Brent partials traded, twice at $17.60, twice at $17.62 and once at $17.65 a barrel, compared to the IPE settlement of $17.68.
An August partial traded at $17.85 a barrel, down 10 cents from the London close.
July/August Brent changed hands at minus 27 cents, down two cents from the lowest deal earlier in the day.
June/July was talked at minus 37/33 cents, while August/September was talked at minus 20/17 cents.
